# NFL Daily — 2026-11-17 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- Patriots fear QB Drake Maye has a fractured ankle that could sideline him for the rest of the season. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50500352/patriots-qb-drake-maye-leg-miss-extended-sources-say)
- Lions DE Aidan Hutchinson tore his ACL and is out for the season, the second key Lions defender lost to a major injury this month. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7786803/2026/11/17/aidan-hutchinson-acl-injury-update-lions/)
- Texans placed LB Azeez Al-Shaair, their leading tackler, on injured reserve; he reportedly faces surgery. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50511791/texans-place-lb-azeez-al-shaair-groin-ir) — also [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/texans-azeez-al-shaair-injury-surgery-ir-2026/)
- Previously winless (0-8) Chargers beat the Ravens 23-20 for their first win of the season. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50506286/ravens-chargers-mnf-herbert-first-win)
- The NFL flexed the Week 12 Raiders-Browns game into Sunday Night Football, moving Patriots-Chargers to 4:05 ET and Titans-Jaguars to 1 p.m. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50512634/nfl-flexes-raiders-browns-snf-slot-week-12)
- Cowboys owner Jerry Jones said Dallas is "talking about" a change at defensive coordinator — Christian Parker would be the team's fifth DC in five seasons. [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/jerry-jones-cowboys-talking-about-change-defensive-coordinator-christian-parker/)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Jets QB Geno Smith (ankle) had tests that showed no major injury; his status will be evaluated through the week. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield (foot) is in question for Sunday — Tampa Bay signed Cooper Rush to the practice squad as insurance. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Packers RB Josh Jacobs (finger, out) has a "realistic chance" to return Nov. 25 against the Rams after the bye. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Colts CB Sauce Gardner (calf) is uncertain for Thursday's game at Houston after exiting Sunday's win. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- 49ers WR Mike Evans (Achilles) is hoped to be back at practice this week, per coach Kyle Shanahan. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-17 (Past 1 day(s))

## Key news
- Ravens (4-6) suffered a stunning 23-20 Monday night loss to the previously winless (0-8) Chargers in Jacoby Brissett's first start, extending the skid to five straight games. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50506286/ravens-chargers-mnf-herbert-first-win)
- With seven games left, Baltimore's odds of landing a top-5 2027 draft pick (8.6%) now exceed its playoff odds (4.1%), per ESPN Analytics. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2122672420884459988)
- TE Mark Andrews revealed he's been playing with a broken left hand since Week 3. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2122554250152620326)
- S Kyle Hamilton said the team is "disgracing" the Ravens' standard after the loss, calling it one of the most embarrassing defeats in franchise history. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50508744/kyle-hamilton-says-ravens-disgracing-standards-loss-previously-winless-chargers)
